original.corpus: 1786 .qvm scripts from a local IGI2 install (originals untouched; copies executed)

analysis.qvm_format: LOOP magic; 8-u32 header (strtab offset); offset table; NUL string table; task/data/bytecode sections

replica.commands: info (header/strings), dis (linear disassembly), run (error-parity executor stub)
